## Built for the Way You Actually Live


The Thungy Brush fits seamlessly into modern routines — no complicated rituals, no compromise. Just a thoughtfully made tool that earns its place in your home every single day.

Designed for grab-and-go convenience, the Thungy Brush stores cleanly, dries quickly, and stays ready — so your routine never has to wait.














### Materials That Matter


Crafted with eco-conscious material thinking at its core — natural fibers, responsibly sourced components, and a production process that respects both your home and the planet.














### Premium Everyday Usability


Every detail — from bristle density to handle balance — is refined for daily use. The kind of quality you notice the first time you use it, and every time after.




































Real People. Real Results.

Our Story

# Crafted with Purpose, Built for Everyday Life.



Thungy Brush was born from a simple conviction: the tools you use every day should work as hard as you do, without costing the earth. We set out to design a brush that brings together thoughtful materials, satisfying form, and honest function — making the mundane feel considered. Every Thungy Brush is an invitation to slow down, do things well, and take quiet pride in a clean, cared-for space.


We believe convenience and mindful consumption aren't opposites. By keeping our product focused and our process transparent, we make it effortless to choose something better — for your home and for the planet. No complicated decisions, no clutter. Just one exceptional brush, ready when you are.

Shop Thungy Brush

































## What Guides Everything We Make














### Simplicity



We believe the best tools get out of your way. Every Thungy Brush product is stripped of excess — no gimmicks, no clutter — so the experience of using it feels effortless and right from the very first moment.














### Thoughtful Design



Good design isn't decoration — it's intention made visible. We obsess over the details that most brands overlook: the balance of the handle, the density of the bristles, the way a brush feels after a hundred uses. Form and function, inseparable.














### Responsible Everyday Use



The products you reach for daily should leave the world a little better. We source materials with care, minimise waste in our process, and build things that last — because responsible choices shouldn't require a second thought.






















## Crafted for the Way You Live


The Thungy Brush is built around one simple idea: premium tools should feel as good as they perform. Every bristle, every handle, every finish is chosen for its tactile quality and lasting durability — so your daily routine feels less like a chore and more like a ritual. Simple, purposeful, and made to last.
































What you see is what you get — no fuss, no compromise. The Thungy Brush is designed to fit seamlessly into any home, any routine, and any aesthetic. Its clean lines and considered weight make it a pleasure to reach for, day after day. Premium simplicity, delivered.

Shop Thungy Brush

## Common Questions


Everything you need to know before you buy your Thungy Brush.







01

### How do I buy a Thungy Brush?




Buying is designed to be as simple as possible. Scroll to the Buy section on this page, choose your preferred option, and click the buy button — you'll be taken directly to a secure checkout. No accounts required, no complicated steps. Just pick, click, and it's on its way to you.








02

### What makes the Thungy Brush worth it?




The Thungy Brush is crafted for people who care about quality in the everyday. It's built to last, feels premium in the hand, and delivers noticeably better results than what you're used to. Once you try it, you'll wonder how you managed without one. It's the kind of product that earns its place in your routine — and stays there.








03

### What's the story behind Thungy Brush llc?




Thungy Brush llc was founded on a simple belief: the tools you use every day should be genuinely good. We set out to create something that didn't compromise on materials, feel, or function. Our approach is straightforward — make it well, stand behind it, and keep the experience of buying and owning it refreshingly uncomplicated.








04

### Still have questions? How do I get in touch?




We'd love to hear from you. Whether you have a question before buying, need help with an order, or just want to know more about the product, reach out directly using the contact form below or drop us a message. We're a small team and we read every message personally — expect a real reply, not a bot.

Send Us a Message

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 6/2/2026



At Thungy Brush llc, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: [business_email]


Phone: [business_phone]


Address: [business_address]

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/28/2026



Thungy Brush llc ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Thungy Brush llc

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 28, 2026



Thungy Brush llc is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Thungy Brush llc

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
